articles.title: GHSA: GitPython: Unguarded git option forwarding in Repo.init enables arbitrary command execution via --template clone hooks
articles.summary:
## Summary
`Repo.init()` forwards `**kwargs` verbatim to `git init` with no unsafe-option guard and no `allow_unsafe_options` parameter. `git init --template=<dir>` copies `<dir>/hooks/*` into the new repo's `.git/hooks`, so an attacker-controlled `template` kwarg plants a hook that executes on the next git operation → arbitrary code execution. `--template` is already recognized as unsafe for clon

articles.summary:
